title: GLOW-FM: Efficient Generative Low-Light Image Enhancement with One-Step Latent Flow Matching
title_zh: GLOW-FM：基于单步潜在流匹配的高效生成式低光照图像增强

paragraphs.en: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) aims to recover well-exposed and perceptually faithful images from severely degraded observations. Recent diffusion-based generative methods achieve strong perceptual quality by leveraging powerful image priors, but their iterative sampling incurs substantial computational cost, limiting practical deployment. Despite recent efficiency gains in generative LLIE, high-quality enhancement with a single function evaluation and low overall computation remains challenging, particularly under diverse real-world low-light conditions. We introduce GLOW-FM , a one-step latent flow-matching framework for efficient generative LLIE. GLOW-FM performs conditional transport in the latent space of a frozen Tiny-VAE and leverages Terminal Velocity Matching (TVM) to enable enhancement with a single function evaluation. Matched comparisons with alternative one-step objectives support TVM as an effective design choice, and, to the best of our knowledge, this is its first adaptation to image restoration and specifically to LLIE. Extensive experiments on challenging real-world benchmarks demonstrate that GLOW-FM achieves competitive image quality and state-of-the-art cross-dataset generalization while requiring only a single function evaluation and 34 GFLOPs for the small variant. These findings highlight the potential of GLOW-FM to bring generative LLIE closer to practical deployment through single-step inference and compact latent modeling. Code is available at https://github.com/arm-research/AAIR-GLOW-FM .

paragraphs.en: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) aims to recover well-exposed and visually pleasing images from observations captured under insufficient illumination. Real-world low-light images often exhibit a complex combination of degradations, including severe underexposure, sensor noise, color distortion, reduced contrast, detail loss, and local saturation, which vary significantly across cameras and imaging conditions, making LLIE a challenging problem in real-world imaging [ 8 , 6 , 28 ] . Beyond degrading visual quality, these artifacts also impair downstream computer vision tasks such as object detection and recognition, whose performance declines substantially on poorly exposed inputs [ 32 ] . Consequently, LLIE seeks not only to enhance image appearance but also to restore perceptually faithful content that supports reliable high-level vision applications [ 16 , 40 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 低光照图像增强（LLIE）旨在从光照不足条件下捕获的观测图像中恢复曝光良好且视觉效果令人满意的图像。 真实世界的低光照图像往往呈现复杂的退化组合，包括严重欠曝、传感器噪声、色彩失真、对比度降低、细节丢失和局部饱和，这些退化在不同相机和成像条件下差异显著，使低光照图像增强成为真实世界成像中一个具有挑战性的问题 [ 8 , 6 , 28 ] 。 这些伪影不仅有损视觉质量，还会损害诸如目标检测与识别等下游计算机视觉任务，使其在曝光不良的输入上性能大幅下降 [ 32 ] 。 因此，低光照图像增强不仅要提升图像外观，还要恢复感知上忠实的内容，以支持可靠的高层视觉应用 [ 16 , 40 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Regression-based LLIE methods provide strong distortion performance and efficient inference [ 4 , 5 , 62 , 68 , 61 , 69 , 58 , 7 , 59 , 45 , 54 ] . These approaches typically optimize distortion-oriented objectives and are effective at recovering visibility and suppressing noise, but often struggle under severe degradation, where substantial information loss makes enhancement inherently ambiguous. Trained with pixel-wise objectives, they tend to produce overly smooth results and suppress fine details [ 3 ] . To address this limitation, generative models [ 19 , 65 , 21 , 55 , 66 , 22 , 17 ] have emerged as a powerful LLIE paradigm, learning the distribution of natural images and leveraging strong image priors to recover realistic textures and structures that are difficult to reconstruct with deterministic networks. These methods demonstrate substantial improvements in perceptual quality and robustness under severe degradations. However, these gains come at the cost of iterative sampling, resulting in high computational complexity and limiting practical deployment, particularly for high-resolution enhancement in resource-constrained applications such as smartphone camera image processing.

paragraphs.en: To address this limitation, several efficient generative LLIE frameworks have recently been proposed [ 20 , 70 , 25 ] . These methods significantly reduce the required number of function evaluations (NFEs) compared to conventional diffusion models. Nevertheless, they still rely on iterative refinement procedures and diffusion-inspired architectures whose computational complexity remains substantial. For example, WCDM [ 20 ] requires 10 NFEs and approximately 90 GFLOPs during inference, while ReDDiT [ 25 ] reduces sampling to 2 NFEs but still requires roughly 128 GFLOPs. Consequently, while recent generative LLIE approaches have substantially reduced sampling cost, achieving high-quality enhancement with a single inference step and a low overall computational budget remains an active challenge, particularly across diverse and demanding real-world low-light conditions.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we address this challenge by introducing an efficient G enerative Low -Light image enhancement with one-step latent F low M atching ( GLOW-FM ). Our approach leverages Terminal Velocity Matching (TVM) [ 71 ] , which enables direct prediction of the normal-light image, eliminating the need for iterative sampling during inference. Comparisons with standard Flow Matching [ 30 , 31 ] , Consistency Flow Matching [ 63 ] , and MeanFlow [ 12 ] establish Terminal Velocity Matching (TVM) [ 71 ] as a deliberate design choice for single-step LLIE. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first adaptation of TVM to image restoration, and specifically to LLIE. GLOW-FM learns a conditional transport that maps degraded low-light representations directly to their well-exposed counterparts in the latent space of a frozen Tiny-VAE [ 49 ] . Operating in this compact latent space substantially reduces computational cost while preserving the expressive power of generative modeling. Moreover, latent representations capture semantic image structure while suppressing dataset-specific variations, improving restoration and generalization [ 51 , 29 , 48 ] .

paragraphs.en: Extensive experiments on challenging real-world low-light benchmarks [ 45 , 54 ] demonstrate that GLOW-FM provides an effective generative prior for low-light enhancement while operating under small inference budgets. Despite requiring only a single NFE, our method achieves image quality competitive with recent efficient generative LLIE approaches and consistently exhibits strong cross-dataset generalization as shown in Fig. 1 . These results suggest that latent flow matching, combined with one-step TVM estimation, offers a promising direction toward practical, high-quality, and computationally efficient low-light image enhancement.

paragraphs.en: We introduce GLOW-FM, an efficient generative framework for low-light image enhancement (LLIE) based on latent flow matching. By performing enhancement in a compact latent space with a lightweight Tiny-VAE and a one-step flow formulation, GLOW-FM achieves high restoration quality at low computational cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 GLOW-FM，一种基于潜空间流匹配的低光照图像增强（LLIE）高效生成式框架。 通过使用轻量级的 Tiny-VAE 和一步流公式在紧凑的潜空间中执行增强，GLOW-FM 以较低的计算成本实现了高恢复质量。

sents.en: We introduce GLOW-FM, an efficient generative framework for low-light image enhancement (LLIE) based on latent flow matching.

sents.en: By performing enhancement in a compact latent space with a lightweight Tiny-VAE and a one-step flow formulation, GLOW-FM achieves high restoration quality at low computational cost.

paragraphs.en: We establish Terminal Velocity Matching (TVM) as the strongest overall one-step objective for LLIE through matched comparisons with Rectified Flow, Consistency Flow Matching, and MeanFlow. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first adaptation of TVM to image restoration, specifically LLIE.

paragraphs.en: We achieve state-of-the-art cross-dataset generalization compared to generative and non-generative baselines, while maintaining competitive image quality and improved efficiency over existing generative LLIE methods.
paragraphs.zh: 与生成式和非生成式基线相比，我们实现了最先进的跨数据集泛化能力，同时在图像质量上保持竞争力，并比现有的生成式低光图像增强（LLIE）方法具有更高的效率。

paragraphs.en: A large body of LLIE research focuses on directly regressing a normal-light image from a low-light input using Retinex decomposition [ 26 ] , illumination estimation, and deep neural networks [ 5 , 62 , 45 , 4 ] . While these approaches are computationally efficient, they often produce overly smooth results and struggle to capture the diversity of plausible normal-light reconstructions. The recent success of diffusion models [ 18 ] in image generation has motivated their adoption for high-quality low-light image enhancement [ 65 , 19 , 25 , 70 , 20 , 17 , 21 ] . Diff-Retinex [ 65 ] formulates enhancement as Retinex decomposition followed by conditional diffusion-based reconstruction of reflectance and illumination components. GSAD [ 19 ] introduces a global structure-aware diffusion framework that combines curvature-based regularization with uncertainty-guided optimization to preserve scene structure and focus restoration on challenging regions. Subsequent work has largely aimed to reduce the high computational cost of diffusion sampling. ReDDiT [ 25 ] uses trajectory matching distillation in a reflectance-aware residual space to reduce the NFEs required at inference. PyDiff [ 70 ] performs denoising in a coarse-to-fine resolution pyramid and employs a global correction module to mitigate brightness and color inconsistencies. WCDM [ 20 ] accelerates inference by conducting diffusion in the wavelet domain on low-frequency sub-bands while restoring high-frequency details through a dedicated branch. Reti-Diff [ 17 ] generates compact latent Retinex priors to guide a transformer-based restoration network, while LightenDiffusion [ 21 ] combines latent Retinex decomposition with diffusion for unsupervised LLIE. Related concurrent preprints, IllumFlow [ 57 ] and Consist-Retinex [ 60 ] , further explore one-step generative LLIE through Retinex-based decomposition.

paragraphs.en: Generative diffusion and flow models have achieved remarkable success across a wide range of image-generation tasks. Their strong priors have also motivated applications to image restoration, where the goal is to recover a clean image from a degraded observation. InDI [ 11 ] performs restoration through direct iteration, while IR-SDE [ 35 ] models the restoration trajectory using a mean-reverting stochastic process. Bridge-matching methods [ 46 ] further formalize transport between degraded and clean endpoint distributions, and flow-based approaches such as FlowIE [ 73 ] and PnP-Flow [ 37 ] extend this formulation to image restoration. Despite their strong restoration capabilities, these methods commonly require iterative sampling, resulting in substantial inference cost. Early acceleration approaches employed fast post-hoc samplers [ 47 , 34 , 23 ] , reducing inference from hundreds of steps to tens, often at the expense of quality under aggressive acceleration. More recently, flow-based objectives have been developed specifically for efficient one- and few-step generation. Rectified Flow [ 31 ] learns straighter transport trajectories, while Consistency Flow Matching [ 63 ] regularizes the velocity field for few-step inference. ELIR [ 9 ] applies Consistency Flow Matching to image restoration in the latent space of a Tiny AutoEncoder. MeanFlow [ 12 ] learns mean transport trajectories, whereas TVM [ 71 ] learns finite displacements between arbitrary timesteps for high-fidelity one- and few-step generation. Despite these advances, efficient flow-based generation remains relatively unexplored for LLIE. Building upon TVM, we introduce a single-step latent flow-matching framework for efficient low-light enhancement.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式扩散模型与流模型在广泛的图像生成任务中取得了显著成功。 它们强大的先验也推动了在图像修复领域的应用，其目标是从退化的观测中恢复出干净的图像。 InDI [11] 通过直接迭代执行修复，而 IR-SDE [35] 使用均值回归随机过程对修复轨迹进行建模。 桥匹配方法 [46] 进一步形式化了退化端点分布与干净端点分布之间的传输，而诸如 FlowIE [73] 和 PnP-Flow [37] 等基于流的方法则将这一公式扩展到图像修复。 尽管这些方法具有强大的修复能力，但它们通常需要迭代采样，导致巨大的推理开销。 早期的加速方法采用快速的事后采样器 [47, 34, 23]，将推理从数百步减少到数十步，但在激进加速下往往以牺牲质量为代价。 近年来，基于流的目标函数被专门开发用于高效的单步和少步生成。 Rectified Flow [31] 学习更平直的传输轨迹，而 Consistency Flow Matching [63] 对速度场进行正则化以实现少步推理。 ELIR [9] 将 Consistency Flow Matching 应用于 Tiny AutoEncoder 的潜在空间中的图像修复。 MeanFlow [12] 学习平均传输轨迹，而 TVM [71] 学习任意时间步之间的有限位移，以实现高保真的单步和少步生成。 尽管有这些进展，基于流的高效生成在低光照图像增强（LLIE）领域仍相对未被充分探索。 在 TVM 的基础上，我们提出了一种用于高效低光照增强的单步潜在流匹配框架。

paragraphs.en: Compact Latent Representation. Operating in latent space is central to the efficiency of GLOW-FM. Instead of applying the flow model to full-resolution RGB images, the VAE encoder maps the input into a lower-dimensional representation with reduced spatial resolution. The learned transport therefore acts on a compact latent grid, lowering the cost of each function evaluation and making low-NFE inference more practical.
paragraphs.zh: 紧凑的潜在表示。 在潜在空间中运行是 GLOW-FM 高效性的核心。 VAE 编码器不是将流模型应用于全分辨率 RGB 图像，而是将输入映射到空间分辨率更低的低维表示中。 因此，所学习的传输作用于紧凑的潜在网格，降低了每次函数评估的成本，并使低 NFE 推理更加切实可行。

paragraphs.en: The latent space also provides a useful restoration prior. Since the VAE is pretrained on a broad natural-image distribution, its representation captures reusable image structure while suppressing some pixel-level noise and dataset-specific degradation patterns. Prior work has similarly shown that pretrained latent representations can support robust image restoration and domain generalization [ 51 , 29 , 48 ] . As a result, the flow model learns exposure and appearance corrections in a natural-image latent domain rather than relying solely on dataset-specific pixel statistics. For the autoencoder, inspired by [ 9 ] , we use Tiny AutoEncoder for Stable Diffusion (TAESD) [ 49 ] , a lightweight distilled alternative to the Stable Diffusion VAE (SD-VAE) [ 44 ] . TAESD preserves an SD-VAE-compatible latent interface while substantially reducing the cost of encoding and decoding. In our implementation, replacing SD-VAE with TAESD reduces encoding/decoding GFLOPs by 15 × 15\times and parameter count by 33 × 33\times , with minimal loss in end-to-end restoration performance. This is important for low-NFE generation, where the flow model requires only one or a few evaluations and the VAE cost becomes a significant part of the total inference budget.

paragraphs.en: HDiT two-time flow model. We implement the two-time conditioned flow model F θ ​ ( z t , t , s ) F_{\theta}(z_{t},t,s) with an Hourglass Diffusion Transformer (HDiT) backbone. HDiT combines the multi-scale efficiency of U-Net-like architectures with the representation capacity of diffusion transformers [ 10 ] . Unlike standard DiT-style architectures [ 42 ] , which apply global attention at every resolution and incur O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) attention cost, HDiT restricts global attention to low-resolution stages and uses fixed-window neighborhood attention at higher resolutions, yielding linear O ⁡ ( n ) O(n) scaling with the number of latent image tokens. This design is useful for GLOW-FM because latent restoration requires both global exposure/color correction and preservation of spatially aligned local content from the degraded input, while keeping the two-time flow model efficient at inference.

paragraphs.en: Datasets. We evaluate GLOW-FM on both paired and unpaired real-world LLIE benchmarks. Our primary benchmark is LSD-DLL [ 45 ] , a large-scale dataset designed to improve the realism and diversity of LLIE evaluation. Unlike many earlier low-light datasets [ 7 , 64 , 15 ] , which are limited by synthetic darkening, controlled capture settings, or restricted sensor coverage, LSD-DLL [ 45 ] provides real low and normal-light image pairs captured across diverse scenes and devices in the wild using dynamic exposure calibration and multi-frame alignment to obtain more realistic paired data. As a result, it better captures phenomena such as sensor noise, spatially varying illumination, and color distortions that are often underrepresented in existing LLIE benchmarks. These properties motivated its use as the benchmark dataset in [ 8 ] . LSD-DLL also provides the LSD-U test split, which consists of unpaired low-light images captured with unseen devices and enables evaluation of generalization beyond the paired training distribution. To complement LSD-DLL, we additionally evaluate on UHD-LOL4K [ 54 ] , a high-resolution LLIE benchmark, and LOL-v1 [ 7 ] , one of the most widely used datasets in the LLIE literature.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集。 我们在成对与不成对的真实世界低光照图像增强（LLIE）基准上评估 GLOW-FM。 我们的主要基准是 LSD-DLL [ 45 ]，这是一个旨在提升 LLIE 评估真实性与多样性的大规模数据集。 与许多早期低光照数据集 [ 7 , 64 , 15 ] 受限于合成变暗、受控拍摄设置或有限的传感器覆盖范围不同，LSD-DLL [ 45 ] 提供了在多样场景和真实野外设备上拍摄的真实低光照与正常光照图像对，并使用动态曝光校准和多帧对齐来获得更真实的成对数据。 因此，它能更好地捕捉传感器噪声、空间变化的照明和色彩失真等现象，而这些现象在现有 LLIE 基准中往往表现不足。 这些特性使其被用作 [ 8 ] 中的基准数据集。 LSD-DLL 还提供了 LSD-U 测试划分，该划分由使用未见设备拍摄的不成对低光照图像组成，可用于评估超越成对训练分布的泛化能力。 为补充 LSD-DLL，我们还在 UHD-LOL4K [ 54 ]（一个高分辨率 LLIE 基准）和 LOL-v1 [ 7 ]（LLIE 文献中使用最广泛的数据集之一）上进行了额外评估。

paragraphs.en: Implementation details. GLOW-FM employs a frozen Tiny-VAE [ 49 ] to obtain 16-channel latent image representations, while only the latent flow model is optimized during training. Unless otherwise specified, experiments use the GLOW-FM-XL configuration with a single NFE. We additionally evaluate medium (M) and small (S) configurations, which differ only in the capacity of the HDiT backbone. Source latents are perturbed with Gaussian noise using σ = 0.01 \sigma=0.01 . Models are trained for approximately 100k optimization steps on 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs. For LSD-DLL and UHD-LOL4K, we trained the baselines on the respective training sets, whereas all other results use the authors’ official code and checkpoints. Appendix D details these baseline training protocols together with our implementation, hyperparameters, and runtime and memory analyses.

paragraphs.en: Comparison of one-step objectives. Tab. 5 compares TVM with MeanFlow [ 12 ] , ConsistencyFM [ 63 ] and No-TVM (standard Flow Matching [ 30 , 31 ] ), with all other experimental settings held fixed. We additionally evaluate No-TVM at 25 NFEs. Among the matched TAESD one-step variants, TVM achieves the strongest overall distortion and perceptual performance. MeanFlow forms its JVP target from the initial-time velocity, whose sample-wise approximation can destabilize training [ 71 ] ; this may be particularly problematic for LLIE, where the initial state is a degraded low-light image. ConsistencyFM enforces a velocity-consistent straight flow, which may restrict a single full-interval mapping for spatially heterogeneous restoration [ 63 , 9 ] . TVM instead regularizes the displacement at its predicted terminal state, aligning the one-step mapping with the velocity near the enhanced endpoint [ 71 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 单步目标的比较。 表5将TVM与MeanFlow [12]、ConsistencyFM [63]和No-TVM（标准流匹配 [30, 31]）进行比较，其他实验设置均保持不变。 我们还在25次NFE下评估了No-TVM。 在匹配的TAESD单步变体中，TVM实现了最强的整体失真与感知性能。 MeanFlow使用初始时刻的速度来构建其JVP目标，其逐样本近似可能使训练不稳定 [71]；这对LLIE而言可能尤为成问题，因为其初始状态是退化的低光照图像。 ConsistencyFM强制执行速度一致的直线路径流，这可能限制空间异质性修复的单一全区间映射 [63, 9]。 TVM则在其预测的终端状态处对位移进行正则化，使单步映射与增强终点附近的速度对齐 [71]。

paragraphs.en: Effect of latent representation. Tab. 5 further evaluates the effect of the latent representation on GLOW-FM performance. We compare the proposed TAESD latent representation against a larger SD-VAE and a direct pixel-space variant while keeping the velocity network fixed. TAESD achieves better PSNR, SSIM, and NIQE with nearly an order of magnitude less computation, whereas SD-VAE achieves better LPIPS and MUSIQ at substantially higher computational and parameter costs. Additional autoencoder-reconstruction analysis is provided in Appendix E . We further compare against a pixel-space variant that removes the latent representation entirely. Despite requiring significantly more computation, direct pixel-space modeling produces substantially weaker distortion and perceptual quality. These results indicate that the proposed latent-space formulation is not only computationally advantageous but also improves enhancement quality, suggesting that the compact TAESD representation provides an effective latent space for LLIE.

paragraphs.en: Low-light image enhancement remains challenging because noise, color shifts, and information loss make faithful restoration ambiguous. paragraphs.en: In this work, we address this challenge with GLOW-FM, an efficient generative LLIE framework based on one-step latent flow matching. By combining efficiency-aware latent flow matching with Terminal Velocity Matching, GLOW-FM enables single-NFE enhancement while preserving generative priors for realistic restoration. Experiments show competitive quality, improved efficiency, and state-of-the-art cross-dataset generalization, suggesting a practical direction for robust and efficient generative low-light enhancement.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 GLOW-FM 来应对这一挑战，这是一种基于单步潜在流匹配的高效生成式低光照图像增强框架。 通过将效率感知的潜在流匹配与终端速度匹配相结合，GLOW-FM 能够在单次网络前向评估下完成增强，同时保留用于真实复原的生成先验。 实验表明，该方法具有有竞争力的质量、更高的效率以及最先进的跨数据集泛化能力，为稳健且高效的生成式低光照图像增强指明了一个实用方向。

paragraphs.en: Unless otherwise specified, all experiments use a frozen Tiny-VAE encoder/decoder while optimizing only the latent flow model. Models are trained on 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs with a per-GPU batch size of 2 (effective batch size 16) for approximately 100k optimization steps. Optimization uses AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , betas ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) , weight decay 0.01 0.01 , gradient clipping at norm 1.0 1.0 , and EMA decay 0.9999 0.9999 . The learning rate follows a 5k-step warmup with cosine decay to a minimum learning-rate ratio of 0.01 0.01 . Training uses random 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 crops for LSD-DLL and UHD-LOL4K, and 384 × 384 384\times 384 crops for LOL-v1. Validation uses a batch size of 1 and is performed at the original image resolution. Source latents are perturbed with Gaussian noise using σ = 0.01 \sigma=0.01 during training and σ = 0 \sigma=0 during evaluation. Unless otherwise specified, all reported results use a single NFE.

paragraphs.en: We use the official madebyollin/taesd3 [ 49 ] checkpoint as a frozen Tiny-VAE image tokenizer. TAESD is a lightweight autoencoder distilled from the Stable Diffusion VAE (SD-VAE) [ 44 ] , providing a compact alternative for encoding and decoding images. RGB images are encoded into 16-channel latent representations, and the flow model operates entirely in this latent space. The encoder and decoder remain frozen throughout training, and no additional latent normalization is applied. During inference, the predicted latent representation is decoded using the same frozen Tiny-VAE decoder before computing image-space evaluation metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用官方的 madebyollin/taesd3 [49] 检查点作为冻结的 Tiny-VAE 图像分词器。 TAESD 是从 Stable Diffusion VAE（SD-VAE）[44] 蒸馏得到的轻量级自编码器，为图像的编码与解码提供了一种紧凑的替代方案。 RGB 图像被编码为 16 通道的潜在表示，流模型完全在该潜在空间中运行。 编码器和解码器在整个训练过程中保持冻结，并且不应用额外的潜在归一化。 在推理阶段，预测得到的潜在表示会先使用同一个冻结的 Tiny-VAE 解码器进行解码，然后再计算图像空间的评估指标。

paragraphs.en: For LSD-DLL and UHD-LOL4K, we independently retrained every baseline on the corresponding training set using the authors’ official code and method-specific training recipe. We retained the official architecture, optimization settings, and training schedule, modifying only the dataset configuration as necessary. For LOL-v1, we used the official pretrained weights released by the respective authors whenever available. TFFormer was the only exception: because no official LOL-v1 checkpoint was available, we also trained it from scratch on the LOL-v1 training set. Unless otherwise stated, the training details below describe our retraining on LSD-DLL and UHD-LOL4K, and all models were trained using NVIDIA H100 GPUs.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 LSD-DLL 和 UHD-LOL4K，我们使用作者官方代码和各方法专属的训练方案，在相应训练集上独立重新训练了每个基线方法。 我们保留了官方的网络架构、优化设置和训练计划，仅在必要时修改数据集配置。 对于 LOL-v1，只要作者发布了官方预训练权重，我们就直接使用。 TFFormer 是唯一的例外：由于没有官方的 LOL-v1 检查点可用，我们也在 LOL-v1 训练集上从零开始训练了该模型。 除非另有说明，下文所述的训练细节均指我们在 LSD-DLL 和 UHD-LOL4K 上的重新训练，且所有模型均在 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上训练。

paragraphs.en: We trained a separate TFFormer model from scratch on each of LSD-DLL, UHD-LOL4K, and LOL-v1. TFFormer was optimized using an Adam optimizer with hyperparameters β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 and β 2 = 0.99 \beta_{2}=0.99 . paragraphs.en: Figures 6 and 7 analyze the effect of the number of function evaluations (NFEs). Figure 6 reports PSNR and NIQE, while Fig. 7 extends the evaluation to SSIM, LPIPS-VGG, LPIPS-Alex, MUSIQ, and CLIP-IQA. Across these metrics, the TVM-trained variants remain largely stable as the number of NFEs increases, whereas No-TVM improves substantially from one to 25 NFEs. The largest improvement is observed for LPIPS-VGG, for which No-TVM surpasses the TVM-trained model after only a few NFEs. The remaining metrics, including LPIPS-Alex, converge toward performance comparable to that of the TVM-trained model operating with a single NFE. As reported in Tab. 7 , No-TVM at 25 NFEs achieves lower LPIPS; however, one-step TVM retains slightly better PSNR and NIQE with an 8.6 × 8.6\times reduction in GFLOPs. Overall, these results are consistent with the designs of the respective objectives and demonstrate that TVM provides a favorable quality–efficiency trade-off by achieving competitive image quality with a single NFE.
paragraphs.zh: 图6和图7分析了函数评估次数（NFEs）的影响。 图6报告了PSNR和NIQE，而图7将评估扩展到SSIM、LPIPS-VGG、LPIPS-Alex、MUSIQ和CLIP-IQA。 在这些指标上，随着NFEs数量的增加，经TVM训练的变体基本保持稳定，而无TVM（No-TVM）从1次到25次NFEs则有显著提升。 最大的提升出现在LPIPS-VGG上，无TVM仅需几次NFEs即可超越经TVM训练的模型。 其余指标，包括LPIPS-Alex，逐渐收敛到与以单次NFE运行的经TVM训练的模型相当的性能。 如表7所示，25次NFEs的无TVM取得了更低的LPIPS；然而，单步TVM在GFLOPs减少8.6 × 8.6\times的情况下仍保持了略优的PSNR和NIQE。 总体而言，这些结果与各自目标函数的设计相符，并表明TVM通过以单次NFE实现有竞争力的图像质量，提供了良好的质量—效率权衡。

paragraphs.en: To separate transport-model error from the reconstruction error introduced by the frozen autoencoder, we additionally evaluate direct target reconstruction, x ~ 0 = 𝒟 ⁡ ( ℰ ⁡ ( x 0 ) ) \tilde{x}_{0}=\mathcal{D}(\mathcal{E}(x_{0})) , for TAESD and SD-VAE across the three paired benchmarks. This setting represents the performance obtained when the target encoding is recovered exactly and therefore provides a useful reconstruction reference, but not a strict bound on the output of GLOW-FM. paragraphs.en: Although TAESD uses a substantially smaller encoder and decoder, parameter count alone does not determine the information retained by the latent representation. sents.zh: 本节展示了在多个基准上的补充定性对比，包括在 LSD-U 上对未见设备的泛化能力（图 10）、在 UHD-LOL4K（图 11）和 LSD-DLL（图 13、图 14）上的高分辨率增强，以及在 LOL-v1 上的低分辨率增强（图 12）。

sents.en: In Fig. 15 , we further extend the qualitative generalization comparison shown in Fig. 4 of the main paper with magnified crops to enable closer inspection of dark regions and facilitate comparison with competing methods.
sents.zh: 在图 15 中，我们通过放大的局部裁剪进一步扩展了正文图 4 所示的定性泛化对比，以便更仔细地查看暗部区域，并与竞争方法进行比较。

sents.en: Overall, the results show that GLOW-FM produces natural illumination, preserves scene structure and fine details, and avoids severe visual artifacts across diverse low-light inputs.
sents.zh: 总体而言，结果表明 GLOW-FM 在多样的低光输入下能够产生自然的光照，保留场景结构和精细细节，并避免出现严重的视觉伪影。
